about: Skills rebuild (docs/design/skills-v2.md §2.1): the 28 families, from S1's data/skills.json (its skills, specialisms as focuses, kin, the 252 concepts, the legacy keys a check may name). Seeded by tools/skills2/seed-data.mjs.

families.name: Swordsmanship

concepts.name: the guard
concepts.desc: How to hold the blade between you and harm, always.
concepts.never: Leaves an opening every time the blade moves.

concepts.name: the line
concepts.desc: Cuts and thrusts that travel straight to where they mean to go.
concepts.never: Every cut wanders; the blow arrives late and wide.

concepts.name: the measure
concepts.desc: The distance at which he can strike you and you can strike him.
concepts.never: Always a step too close or a step too far.

concepts.name: the bind
concepts.desc: What to do when the blades meet and press.
concepts.never: Lost the moment steel touches steel.

concepts.name: the tempo
concepts.desc: The beat of a fight, and how to move inside his.
concepts.never: Strikes when the other man is ready for it.

concepts.name: the feint read
concepts.desc: Telling the true attack from the false one.
concepts.never: Taken in by every feint.

concepts.name: the single time
concepts.desc: Defence and attack in one movement.
concepts.never: Parries, then answers: one beat too slow, always.

concepts.name: the stillness
concepts.desc: Doing nothing until the one right thing.
concepts.never: Moves because standing still frightens him.

concepts.name: the sword forgotten
concepts.desc: The art so deep the sword is no longer thought of.
concepts.never: Fights well and thinks about every move.

families.desc: Swords, knives, a blade in each hand: cuts, thrusts and binds.

families.name: Spear, axe and mace

concepts.name: the grip
concepts.desc: How to hold a haft so it does not twist away.
concepts.never: The haft turns in his hands at the first knock.

concepts.name: the point's line
concepts.desc: The point kept on the line to the man.
concepts.never: The point drifts off him whenever he steps.

concepts.name: the measure
concepts.desc: The distance the haft gives you, and how to keep it.
concepts.never: Lets the swordsman inside and has nothing there.

concepts.name: the grounded butt
concepts.desc: Setting the butt to take a charge.
concepts.never: Is carried away by the first horse.

concepts.name: the hook and the pull
concepts.desc: Using the hook and the haft, not only the point.
concepts.never: Only ever pokes.

concepts.name: the rank's rhythm
concepts.desc: Fighting in time with the men on either side.
concepts.never: Breaks the rank by being out of step.

concepts.name: the long tempo
concepts.desc: The slow, long beat of the polearm and how to use it.
concepts.never: Swings as if the haft were a sword.

concepts.name: the yielding haft
concepts.desc: Letting the haft give before it breaks, or you do.
concepts.never: Meets force with force and loses it.

concepts.name: the reach forgotten
concepts.desc: Reach used so well that nobody comes near.
concepts.never: Long weapon, short fighter.

families.desc: Anything swung or thrust on a haft: spear, axe, mace, bill.

families.name: Shield work

concepts.name: the cover
concepts.desc: Keeping the shield where the blow will come.
concepts.never: The shield is where the last blow was.

concepts.name: the edge
concepts.desc: The rim as a weapon and a lever.
concepts.never: Holds the shield like a door, flat and dead.

concepts.name: the angle
concepts.desc: Turning a blow aside instead of taking it square.
concepts.never: Takes every blow full on and tires by noon.

concepts.name: the press
concepts.desc: Pushing with the body behind the boards.
concepts.never: Is shoved back by any man heavier than him.

concepts.name: the gap held
concepts.desc: Holding a gap in the wall when a man falls.
concepts.never: Steps back when the man beside him drops.

concepts.name: the wall's breath
concepts.desc: The whole wall moving and breathing as one.
concepts.never: His shield is a gap in his neighbours' wall.

concepts.name: the shield that strikes
concepts.desc: The shield that strikes as well as covers.
concepts.never: Waits behind the shield for someone else to win.

concepts.name: the weight borrowed
concepts.desc: Using his weight and push against him.
concepts.never: Pushes back hardest when he should give way.

concepts.name: the door that is not there
concepts.desc: Defence so complete the blow finds nothing to hit.
concepts.never: Covers well and still gets hit.

families.desc: The shield as cover, lever and weapon, alone or in a wall.

families.name: Archery

concepts.name: the anchor
concepts.desc: The draw brought to the same place every time.
concepts.never: Draws to a different place each shot.

concepts.name: the loose
concepts.desc: Letting the string go without spoiling the aim.
concepts.never: Plucks the string and throws the shot.

concepts.name: the wind
concepts.desc: What the wind will do to an arrow in flight.
concepts.never: Shoots straight into a crosswind and wonders.

concepts.name: the range by eye
concepts.desc: Judging distance by eye, without a mark.
concepts.never: Every shot short or long by a man's height.

concepts.name: the moving mark
concepts.desc: Leading a moving target.
concepts.never: Shoots where the deer was.

concepts.name: the breath between
concepts.desc: The still moment between breaths.
concepts.never: Shoots on the breath and the shot shakes.

concepts.name: the forearm remembers
concepts.desc: A draw so drilled the arm does it alone.
concepts.never: Thinks through every shot, and is slow.

concepts.name: the far cast
concepts.desc: Long shooting with the whole body behind it.
concepts.never: Out of range at the distance others hit.

concepts.name: the mark that comes to you
concepts.desc: The mark seems to come to the arrow.
concepts.never: Hits what he aims at, and works for it.

families.desc: Bow, crossbow, javelin and sling: anything loosed at a distance.

families.name: Footwork and close fighting

concepts.name: the stance
concepts.desc: A stance that will not be knocked over.
concepts.never: Off balance after his own swing.

concepts.name: the footing
concepts.desc: Footing on any ground: mud, slope, the dead.
concepts.never: Slips on the first wet stone.

concepts.name: the press
concepts.desc: Closing and pushing with the body.
concepts.never: Gives ground whenever pushed.

concepts.name: the second man
concepts.desc: Knowing where the second man is.
concepts.never: Watches one man and is killed by another.

concepts.name: the gap
concepts.desc: Finding the gap in a line or a guard.
concepts.never: Hits shields all day.

concepts.name: the turn of the line
concepts.desc: The moment a line bends and how to turn it.
concepts.never: Stands firm while the line folds around him.

concepts.name: the whole field in the eye
concepts.desc: The whole fight seen at once.
concepts.never: Sees only the man in front of him.

concepts.name: the calm
concepts.desc: Calm in the press, the mind clear.
concepts.never: Panics when he cannot move his arms.

concepts.name: the crowd made slow
concepts.desc: A crowd of foes seems to move slowly.
concepts.never: Fights well, and alone, and is overwhelmed.

families.desc: Feet, balance and the press of bodies in a close fight.

families.name: Riding and the lance

concepts.name: the seat
concepts.desc: Sitting a horse without fighting it.
concepts.never: Bounces in the saddle; the horse hates him.

concepts.name: the hands
concepts.desc: Light, quiet hands on the reins.
concepts.never: Saws at the mouth; the horse fights the bit.

concepts.name: the horse's mind
concepts.desc: What a horse fears and wants.
concepts.never: Is surprised by every shy and balk.

concepts.name: the gallop's balance
concepts.desc: Balance at full gallop over rough ground.
concepts.never: Clings on at a gallop and steers by luck.

concepts.name: the couched point
concepts.desc: The lance couched and carried true to the mark.
concepts.never: The point wavers and glances off.

concepts.name: the two waves
concepts.desc: Riding the rise of the horse and the rise of the fight.
concepts.never: Rides and fights as two separate things.

concepts.name: one body
concepts.desc: Horse and rider as one creature.
concepts.never: A good rider on a horse, not with it.

concepts.name: the line that is still a line
concepts.desc: Keeping a mounted line whole at the charge.
concepts.never: Gallops ahead and leaves the line ragged.

concepts.name: the horse that knows
concepts.desc: A horse that knows his mind before he does.
concepts.never: Commands the horse, and must keep commanding.

families.desc: The saddle: long roads, the fight from horseback, the couched lance.

families.name: Athletics

concepts.name: the breath
concepts.desc: Breathing that keeps up with the body.
concepts.never: Out of breath in the first furlong.

concepts.name: the pace
concepts.desc: A pace that can be held all day.
concepts.never: Sprints, stops, sprints, and is spent.

concepts.name: the fall
concepts.desc: Falling without breaking.
concepts.never: Every fall a sprain.

concepts.name: the second wind
concepts.desc: The second wind found when the first is gone.
concepts.never: Stops when it first hurts.

concepts.name: the long day
concepts.desc: The long day: marching, carrying, still standing.
concepts.never: Done in by afternoon.

concepts.name: the economy
concepts.desc: Not a movement wasted.
concepts.never: Works twice as hard to go half as far.

concepts.name: the body listened to
concepts.desc: Hearing what the body says before it breaks.
concepts.never: Trains through every warning and is injured.

concepts.name: the pain set aside
concepts.desc: Pain set aside when it must be.
concepts.never: Stops at pain, however near the end.

concepts.name: the tirelessness
concepts.desc: Not tiring, as others understand it.
concepts.never: Strong, and tires like other men.

families.desc: Running, climbing, swimming, and lasting the day.

families.name: Wrestling and fists

concepts.name: the base
concepts.desc: A base that is hard to move.
concepts.never: Easily lifted and thrown.

concepts.name: the belt
concepts.desc: The grip on cloth, belt and limb.
concepts.never: Grabs at air.

concepts.name: the measure
concepts.desc: The distance at which hands can reach.
concepts.never: Always too close or too far for his fists.

concepts.name: his strength
concepts.desc: Using his strength against him.
concepts.never: Matches strength with strength and loses to bigger men.

concepts.name: the lock
concepts.desc: Locks on joints that end a fight.
concepts.never: Hits and hits and the fight goes on.

concepts.name: the weight borrowed
concepts.desc: His weight borrowed to throw him.
concepts.never: Pushes when he should pull.

concepts.name: the touch that reads
concepts.desc: Feeling his intent through the grip.
concepts.never: Learns what the other man meant when it lands.

concepts.name: the soft answer
concepts.desc: The soft answer that turns force aside.
concepts.never: Meets every blow with a harder one.

concepts.name: the fight ended before
concepts.desc: Fights ended before they start.
concepts.never: Wins fights he need never have had.

families.desc: Wrestling and fists: the fight with nothing in your hands.

families.name: Command

concepts.name: the voice
concepts.desc: A voice men hear and obey.
concepts.never: Shouts and is not heard.

concepts.name: the order understood
concepts.desc: Orders given so they are understood.
concepts.never: Men do what he said, not what he meant.

concepts.name: the men's mood
concepts.desc: Reading the mood of the men.
concepts.never: Is surprised when they break.

concepts.name: the example
concepts.desc: Leading by being seen to do it.
concepts.never: Commands from the back, and it shows.

concepts.name: the reserve
concepts.desc: Holding men back for the moment that counts.
concepts.never: Commits everything at once.

concepts.name: the count is wrong
concepts.desc: Knowing when the numbers in front of you lie.
concepts.never: Trusts every report.

concepts.name: the army's breath
concepts.desc: The breath of an army: its rest, its push, its limit.
concepts.never: Marches men past what they have.

concepts.name: the ten who trust one another
concepts.desc: Officers who trust one another to act alone.
concepts.never: Every order must come from him.

concepts.name: the banner alone
concepts.desc: A banner men follow when he is not there.
concepts.never: His men are only brave when he is watching.

families.desc: Leading men: the voice, the example, the order understood.

families.name: Tactics and siegecraft

concepts.name: the map
concepts.desc: Reading a map and the ground it means.
concepts.never: Lost between the map and the field.

concepts.name: the ground
concepts.desc: Ground used: slope, river, wood, marsh.
concepts.never: Fights on whatever ground he finds.

concepts.name: the flank
concepts.desc: The flank: protecting yours, turning his.
concepts.never: Is turned on the flank, again.

concepts.name: the supply
concepts.desc: Supply as the first part of any plan.
concepts.never: Wins the march and starves on the field.

concepts.name: the reserve
concepts.desc: Holding back men for the moment that counts.
concepts.never: Commits everything at once.

concepts.name: the enemy's mind
concepts.desc: What the enemy commander wants and fears.
concepts.never: Fights the army and never the general.

concepts.name: the battle refused
concepts.desc: Knowing when not to fight at all.
concepts.never: Accepts every battle offered.

concepts.name: the wall is a sum
concepts.desc: Walls and sieges as arithmetic.
concepts.never: Assaults a wall the sums say will hold.

concepts.name: the war in the first move
concepts.desc: The war decided in the first move.
concepts.never: Wins battles and loses the war.

families.desc: Ground, flank, supply and timing; walls, mines and engines.

families.name: Woodcraft and hunting

concepts.name: the fire
concepts.desc: A fire in the wet, without fuss.
concepts.never: Cold and wet the first night out.

concepts.name: the water
concepts.desc: Finding and judging water.
concepts.never: Drinks from the wrong stream.

concepts.name: the weather read
concepts.desc: Reading tomorrow's weather from today's sky.
concepts.never: Caught in every storm.

concepts.name: the beast's habit
concepts.desc: How beasts live: where, when, why.
concepts.never: Goes looking where the game is not.

concepts.name: the lean season
concepts.desc: Living through the lean season.
concepts.never: Eats well in summer and starves in spring.

concepts.name: the stand
concepts.desc: The hunter's stand: still and unseen.
concepts.never: Fidgets; the deer leave.

concepts.name: the country as larder
concepts.desc: The whole country as a larder.
concepts.never: Starves surrounded by food.

concepts.name: the stillness
concepts.desc: Stillness that the wild does not notice.
concepts.never: Always seen first.

concepts.name: the wild at home
concepts.desc: At home in any wild place.
concepts.never: Survives the wild, and is glad to leave it.

families.desc: Living off the wild: fire, water, weather, the hunt.

families.name: Tracking and scouting

concepts.name: the sign
concepts.desc: Seeing the sign: a print, a bent stem.
concepts.never: Walks over the trail without seeing it.

concepts.name: the age of a trail
concepts.desc: How old a trail is.
concepts.never: Follows yesterday's tracks as if they were fresh.

concepts.name: the broken pattern
concepts.desc: What does not belong in the pattern.
concepts.never: Sees nothing wrong until it is too late.

concepts.name: the wind
concepts.desc: Which way the wind carries scent and sound.
concepts.never: Upwind of everything he hunts.

concepts.name: the mind of the quarry
concepts.desc: Thinking as the quarry thinks.
concepts.never: Follows tracks, never the mind that made them.

concepts.name: the ground ahead
concepts.desc: Seeing the ground ahead before reaching it.
concepts.never: Walks into every ambush.

concepts.name: the trail unseen
concepts.desc: Following a trail that is not there to see.
concepts.never: Lost the moment the ground turns to stone.

concepts.name: the country in the head
concepts.desc: The whole country carried in the head.
concepts.never: Needs a guide in a country he has crossed.

concepts.name: the hunter not there
concepts.desc: Watching unseen, as though not there.
concepts.never: Watches well, and is always noticed.

families.desc: Reading sign, keeping watch, scouting ahead of a host.

families.name: Farming and herding

concepts.name: the seasons
concepts.desc: The year's seasons and what each asks.
concepts.never: Sows late and reaps late.

concepts.name: the soil
concepts.desc: What the soil needs and what it holds.
concepts.never: Ploughs the same field to dust.

concepts.name: the beast's health
concepts.desc: A beast's health read at a glance.
concepts.never: Finds the sick ewe dead.

concepts.name: the fallow
concepts.desc: Letting a field rest.
concepts.never: Gets a fat year and three thin ones.

concepts.name: the breeding line
concepts.desc: Breeding for what you want in five years.
concepts.never: Breeds whatever is at hand.

concepts.name: the bad year stored against
concepts.desc: The bad year stored against.
concepts.never: Is ruined by one bad harvest.

concepts.name: the land's heart
concepts.desc: The land's own heart: what it will and won't do.
concepts.never: Fights his land and always loses.

concepts.name: the eye for stock
concepts.desc: An eye that picks the best beast in a market.
concepts.never: Buys the handsome one, not the good one.

concepts.name: the valley made rich
concepts.desc: A whole valley made rich by one hand.
concepts.never: Keeps a good farm in a poor valley.

families.desc: Fields and beasts: the plough, the herd, horses, vines.

families.name: Seamanship

concepts.name: the knots
concepts.desc: The knots, tied right in the dark.
concepts.never: His knots slip in the first blow.

concepts.name: the wind's eye
concepts.desc: Which way the wind is, without looking.
concepts.never: Is caught aback by every shift.

concepts.name: the tide
concepts.desc: The tide: when, how high, and which way.
concepts.never: Grounds on a falling tide.

concepts.name: the lead and the line
concepts.desc: Depth by the lead and the line.
concepts.never: Learns the depth by touching bottom.

concepts.name: the weather a day off
concepts.desc: Weather seen a day before it comes.
concepts.never: Sails into the storm everyone else stayed out of.

concepts.name: the ship's voice
concepts.desc: What the ship says through the hull.
concepts.never: Hears the mast only when it cracks.

concepts.name: the dead reckoning
concepts.desc: Knowing where you are with no land in sight.
concepts.never: Lost once the coast is out of view.

concepts.name: the lee shore
concepts.desc: Keeping off a lee shore in a blow.
concepts.never: Wrecked on the coast he was warned of.

concepts.name: the sea's temper
concepts.desc: The sea's moods, as a friend knows them.
concepts.never: Respects the sea, and is surprised by it.

families.desc: Ships and water: knots, helm, nets, and the fight at sea.

families.name: Craft

concepts.name: the edge kept
concepts.desc: Tools kept sharp and true.
concepts.never: Works with blunt tools and blames them.

concepts.name: the true line
concepts.desc: A true line: straight, square, level.
concepts.never: Nothing he makes quite fits.

concepts.name: the material's will
concepts.desc: What the iron or wood wants to do.
concepts.never: Fights the grain and splits the work.

concepts.name: the jig
concepts.desc: The jig and the pattern for doing a thing twice.
concepts.never: Every piece made fresh, and each different.

concepts.name: the temper
concepts.desc: The temper: heat and timing.
concepts.never: Blades that bend or shatter.

concepts.name: the hidden fault
concepts.desc: The flaw inside, found before it fails.
concepts.never: Sells work that breaks in a month.

concepts.name: the form that serves
concepts.desc: A form that serves its use.
concepts.never: Makes beautiful things that do not work.

concepts.name: the hand that stops
concepts.desc: Knowing when the work is finished.
concepts.never: Spoils it with one stroke more.

concepts.name: the work that outlasts
concepts.desc: Work that will outlast its maker.
concepts.never: Makes good work that wears out.

families.desc: Making things: iron, wood, stone, cloth and fine work.

families.name: Medicine

concepts.name: the clean hand
concepts.desc: Clean hands and clean dressings.
concepts.never: Wounds he binds go bad.

concepts.name: the pulse
concepts.desc: The pulse and what it says.
concepts.never: Cannot tell sick from dying.

concepts.name: the signs
concepts.desc: Reading signs: skin, eyes, breath, water.
concepts.never: Treats the wrong illness.

concepts.name: the dose
concepts.desc: The dose that heals and the dose that kills.
concepts.never: Poisons as often as he cures.

concepts.name: the fever's course
concepts.desc: How a fever runs, and when it turns.
concepts.never: Panics at the crisis or misses it.

concepts.name: the knife's limit
concepts.desc: Knowing when the knife will do more harm.
concepts.never: Cuts when he should wait.

concepts.name: the patient and not the wound
concepts.desc: The patient, not only the wound.
concepts.never: Mends the arm and loses the man.

concepts.name: the thing not done
concepts.desc: The thing not done, and the restraint it takes.
concepts.never: Must always do something.

concepts.name: the death put off
concepts.desc: Death held off where others would lose.
concepts.never: A good healer, and his patients die as others' do.

families.desc: Wounds, fevers, herbs and births.

families.name: Music, song and dance

concepts.name: the pitch
concepts.desc: Hitting the note.
concepts.never: Sharp, flat, and unaware.

concepts.name: the time
concepts.desc: Keeping time.
concepts.never: Drags and rushes.

concepts.name: the phrase
concepts.desc: Phrasing: where a line breathes.
concepts.never: Every line the same, start to end.

concepts.name: the room
concepts.desc: Playing the room, not only the tune.
concepts.never: Plays to the wall.

concepts.name: the silence
concepts.desc: The silence between notes.
concepts.never: Fills every gap.

concepts.name: the borrowed tune made new
concepts.desc: An old tune made new.
concepts.never: Plays every song as he learned it.

concepts.name: the song that is yours
concepts.desc: A song that is unmistakably his.
concepts.never: Sounds like everyone he admires.

concepts.name: the listeners held
concepts.desc: Holding listeners from first note to last.
concepts.never: They talk through the middle.

concepts.name: the song that stays
concepts.desc: A song that outlives the singer.
concepts.never: Is applauded and forgotten.

families.desc: Voice, strings, the dance and the long lay.

families.name: Trade

concepts.name: the count
concepts.desc: Counting fast and right.
concepts.never: Cheated on the count, every time.

concepts.name: the price
concepts.desc: What a thing is worth, here and today.
concepts.never: Sells cheap and buys dear.

concepts.name: the other man's need
concepts.desc: What the other man needs from the deal.
concepts.never: Haggles over price and loses the bargain.

concepts.name: the weight and the measure
concepts.desc: Weights and measures, and their tricks.
concepts.never: Short-weighted without knowing.

concepts.name: the credit
concepts.desc: Credit: whom to trust, how far.
concepts.never: Lends to the wrong men.

concepts.name: the season ahead
concepts.desc: Buying for the season after this one.
concepts.never: Buys what sold well last year.

concepts.name: the market made
concepts.desc: A market made where there was none.
concepts.never: Trades where trade already is.

concepts.name: the loss taken early
concepts.desc: Taking a loss early.
concepts.never: Holds a bad cargo until it rots.

concepts.name: the name that is coin
concepts.desc: A name that is worth coin by itself.
concepts.never: Rich, and must still show his purse.

families.desc: Buying, selling, judging goods and keeping the count.

families.name: Stewardship and supply

concepts.name: the tally
concepts.desc: The tally kept straight.
concepts.never: Accounts that never balance.

concepts.name: the store
concepts.desc: Stores kept, rotated and guarded.
concepts.never: Grain rotting in the barn.

concepts.name: the yield
concepts.desc: What a holding yields and could yield.
concepts.never: Takes what the land gives and no more.

concepts.name: the honest reeve
concepts.desc: The honest reeve found and kept.
concepts.never: Robbed by his own men.

concepts.name: the lean year
concepts.desc: Planning for the lean year.
concepts.never: Ruined by one hard winter.

concepts.name: the many hands
concepts.desc: Many hands set to one purpose.
concepts.never: Everyone busy, nothing done.

concepts.name: the estate as one thing
concepts.desc: An estate seen as one thing.
concepts.never: Runs each field and loses the whole.

concepts.name: the tax that holds
concepts.desc: A tax that holds without breaking the payer.
concepts.never: Taxes until the village runs.

concepts.name: the house that feeds a realm
concepts.desc: A house that could feed a realm.
concepts.never: Keeps a rich house, and only that.

families.desc: Estates, households, stores and supply; the mint and the tax.

families.name: Gaming and wagers

concepts.name: the odds
concepts.desc: The odds of a throw.
concepts.never: Bets on hunches.

concepts.name: the stake
concepts.desc: What to stake and what to keep.
concepts.never: Stakes everything on one throw.

concepts.name: the tell
concepts.desc: The tell: what a face gives away.
concepts.never: Cannot read a face at the table.

concepts.name: the run that is not there
concepts.desc: The winning run that is not really there.
concepts.never: Chases a streak to ruin.

concepts.name: the table read
concepts.desc: The table as a whole: who is weak, who is cheating.
concepts.never: Plays his hand and nothing else.

concepts.name: the walk away
concepts.desc: Walking away at the right time.
concepts.never: Stays one game too many.

concepts.name: the game behind the game
concepts.desc: The game behind the game.
concepts.never: Plays the dice while others play him.

concepts.name: the calm
concepts.desc: Calm when the money is on the table.
concepts.never: Hands shake when the stakes rise.

concepts.name: the luck made
concepts.desc: Luck that seems to follow him.
concepts.never: Wins steadily, and luck is a stranger.
